metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:scope: One frozen category model, public training histories and targets only; targets may have influenced fitting. No additional scorer, checkpoint or ensemble is fitted or loaded.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:identity: Cache at most ten batches; uniquely match encoded prefix plus aligned target against public training endpoints. Deterministic seed-42 shuffle of eligible user IDs, cap 32, one event each; last eight selected users reserved for confirmation. Selection does not inspect scores or patch results.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:candidates: Diagnostic target plus up to 99 unique uniform alternatives excluding the target and every observed training-history item. Repeat targets are retained exactly once. IDs, shortage and degeneracy are in replay. These are not pinned host candidates; primary summaries require 99 negatives. At most ten candidates makes HR@10 degenerate.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:outcome_vector: Every outcome/delta vector is [raw target-minus-best-alternative margin, one-based target rank, diagnostic HR@10]. Descending computed FP32 scores, then ascending integer item ID; exact equality defines ties. Positive margin/hit change is better; positive rank change is worse.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:stage1: Three independent permutations of earlier occupied positions, with endpoint, padding and earlier-item multiset fixed. No rejection sampling. Identity inputs remain scheduled and have exactly zero input-intervention effect. Input effects are corrupted minus clean; corruption gap is clean minus corrupted.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:stage2: Every eligible draw is patched regardless of score responsiveness. One boundary after block floor(B/2)-1. Choose largest earlier occupied p with r-p in downstream offsets and p-i in upstream offsets for an earlier occupied input i. Patch the complete vector at p after residual addition/masking. Restoration is clean vector into corrupted input; disruption is corrupted vector into clean input. Each delta uses its own recipient baseline.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:contracts: Capture/patch hooks verify exactly one invocation, finite FP32 B x L x H layout, zero padding, donor integrity and exact replacement values. Clean and corrupted identity patches must reproduce features and candidate scores at atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-5. Runtime/contract failures invalidate previously collected site results. Readout, duplicate batch and bounded future checks have limited tested scope; export parity remains unavailable.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:summaries: Only users completing all three scheduled paired draws enter summaries. Average eligible draws within user, then weight contributing users equally. Exploration, confirmation, repetition and candidate-count strata are separate. Responsive subsets are descriptive at 0.1/1/10 tolerance multipliers; all eligible draws are executed. Full scheduled-cohort estimates are unavailable under incomplete coverage; complete-user summaries may be selected by timeout.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:common_user_endpoint_minus: Not scheduled: endpoint replacements are excluded from this protocol.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:intervals: 2000 seed-42 paired user bootstrap replicates only with ten contributing users. Resample full completed user records, retaining nonresponsive users, and recompute subset denominators; report undefined empty-subset replicates. Eight confirmation users therefore have no interval. Conditional on checkpoint, users, candidates and realized draws; excludes training/search/candidate-draw uncertainty and simultaneous guarantees.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:donor_summaries: Not scheduled: no independent-user donor experiment or additional model is used.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:coverage: Replay distinguishes selected, site-ineligible, pending, complete and partial users/draws; includes candidates, permutations, changed IDs, boundary graphs, sites, tolerances, frozen-state SHA256 and raw paired outcomes. Partial pairs never enter estimates. Exact alternative-alternative score ties are recorded per completed corrupted candidate vector; ranking always uses ascending item-ID ties.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:numerics: FP32 checkpoint required, autocast/TF32 disabled, deterministic algorithms requested and original backend settings restored. Existing CuBLAS workspace configuration is recorded, never established retroactively. Unsupported deterministic operations produce explicit failures; no automatic relaxed retry. Fixed-shape checks do not establish hardware/version/batch-shape invariance.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:budget: Synchronized 120-second cumulative category budget, 448 main forwards plus at most 32 extra forwards including preflight. Reserve estimated time before complete main bundles. CPU preparation, hashing and summaries count; reporting stops when the budget is exhausted. An in-flight operation/bootstrap/manifest write is not preempted; final elapsed time and overrun disclose this limitation. Optional incomplete controls are separate from main coverage.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:interpretation: Conditional training dependence only; no inferred intent, ownership, memorization, universal necessity/sufficiency, harmful stale interest, user causality or validation gain. Other temporal positions and direct embedding paths remain unpatched. Single checkpoint, training, architecture, score head, predictor writer, data splits and category routing are unchanged.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:dependencies: Encoder AST must match the supplied fixed-occupancy implementation. FX audits residual functional operations; serial offsets use Minkowski sums, residual and multiplicative/gate paths use unions. Explicit left padding and valid convolution indexing are composed. Unknown operations or preexisting hooks produce unavailable measurements. Structural reachability includes actual changed IDs and does not guarantee score effects. Positional-cumsum dependencies are conditioned on unchanged occupancy.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:controls: First two structurally eligible users, first nonidentity draw: deliberate tensor alteration, bidirectional coherent occupied window and whole-output patches, plus an unreachable occupied site if one exists. Window is a contiguous superset of downstream-reachable positions. Whole-output patches do not capture direct current-input-embedding bypasses and are not certified donor-restoration controls. These users support descriptive comparisons only; hybrid-state norms/distances cannot certify distributional support.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_collapse_score: (mean off-diagonal normalized item-embedding cosine + 1)/2, at most 2048 nonpadding items, seed 42. Alignment only; not diversity or a dimensional-collapse certificate.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:readout_scoring: ModelView receives B x 1 x H features gathered at the original maximum occupied index and B x 1 x N candidates. This preserves its sequence axis while avoiding candidate scoring at unused positions. Readout and duplicate-batch preflight checks gate subsequent measurements.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pending_donor_assignments: Independent donor assignments are not scheduled.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:missing_patch_direction_ob: All structurally eligible scheduled site/direction opportunities minus valid complete-user observations, including incomplete and invalidated work; never interpreted as zero effects.
